## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.4

Community **pre-release** of the **2.6** line (follows `2.6.0-alpha.3`). Ships **2.6.r re-check** remediations (quality gate / Sonar harden + dead-code simplify). Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **Quality / Sonar remediations** — float-eq fix (`ha_units`), Actions SHA pins + job permissions, path/URL hardening (`report_repo_stats`), share-root validation (`remote_backtesting_support`), explicit Dockerfile `COPY` + tighter `.dockerignore`
- **Dead-code / KPI simplify** — remove unused chart/simulation helpers; split long MILP/battery/mapping functions; Sonar ignore for agentic LLM CLI rules (`S8707`/`S8705`)
- **Docs / README** — Monitor hero uses 48h preview asset; alpha compose + container docs pin this tag

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.4` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
